name: Starblue Ranger
description: The Starblue Ranger was a ILH-KK Citadel-class civilian cruiser owned by the Wookiee hunter known as Captain Shorwarr. The Wookiee, who made a living hunting predatory nexu on the planet Cholganna, used the starship during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic. The ship, from a line of armored transports manufactured by Koensayr Manufacturing, was customized to included cages and storage compartments in the hull.
